note: Small private RV park on US-127 in the Sequatchie Valley near Dunlap, minutes from Fall Creek Falls State Park, with a shower house and a market across the road. No extended stays; management may turn away RVs it judges too old or worn. --Claude
summary: Operating private transient RV park: 15 RV sites (14 full hookup + 1 W/E, all 30/50A), $38 (30A) / $42 (50A) + tax, phone reservations up to 3 months out, 'No extended stays', closed Dec 1-Mar 31, dump + shower house. Google 4.9/97. Passes the price gate and long-stay tests.
